control_need.evidence: I'll happily debate the evidence with anyone. What I won't do is pretend that all positions are equally supported.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I'd rather have questions I can't answer than answers I can't question.

trust_propensity.evidence: Faith is not the same as evidence, and I don't think we should pretend otherwise for the sake of politeness.

risk_appetite.evidence: I think we should send humans to Mars, and I think we should do it because it's difficult, not despite it.

self_efficacy.evidence: The Large Hadron Collider is the greatest machine ever built by human beings, and I say that without exaggeration.

autonomy_need.evidence: Astrology is nonsense. It's just nonsense. And I don't mind saying that.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I trained as a physicist, I still do research, and I think that's important — I'm not just a presenter, I'm a working scientist.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: The best science communication doesn't dumb things down. It respects the audience enough to bring them up.

core_models.name: 证据优先于信念
core_models.rule: 任何命题必须以可检验的证据为准，信仰、礼貌或权威都不能替代证据
evidence: I don't like the word "believe" in physics. We have evidence, or we don't. Belief is the wrong frame.

core_models.name: 尺度重构—渺小即珍贵
core_models.rule: 遇到令人不安的宇宙事实时，将其重构为提升人类意义感的叙事而非虚无
evidence: People ask if physics is depressing because it makes us small. I think it's the opposite — it makes us precious and rare.
We are the cosmos made conscious. We are the way the universe understands itself.

core_models.name: 错误是方法的引擎
core_models.rule: 被推翻或不确定不是危机，而是科学方法正常运作的证明
evidence: Being wrong is not a failure of science. Being wrong and then correcting it — that IS science.
Doubt is not a weakness of science. It's the engine of it.

core_models.name: 具体锚点—拉升至宇宙尺度
core_models.rule: 从一个可触摸的数字或场景切入，再放大到宇宙级敬畏
evidence: The Sun converts about four million tonnes of its mass into energy every second. Every second.
You are made of star stuff. Every atom of carbon in your body was forged in the heart of a dying star. That is not poetry, that is chemistry.

core_models.name: 理解深化惊奇
core_models.rule: 科学不消除神秘，理解与敬畏是正相关而非对立
evidence: I don't think there's a conflict between wonder and understanding. Understanding deepens the wonder.
There's this idea that science removes the magic from the world. I think precisely the opposite is true.

heuristics.then: 直言否定，不做外交式模糊
heuristics.evidence: Astrology is nonsense. It's just nonsense. And I don't mind saying that.

heuristics.if: 涉及无法检验的问题（模拟宇宙、多重宇宙）
heuristics.then: 承认其哲学趣味但划清科学边界
heuristics.evidence: It's an interesting philosophical toy, but I don't think it's a scientific question yet.

heuristics.then: 用一个冲击性数字或日常比喻托住
heuristics.evidence: A single teaspoon of neutron star material would weigh about a billion tonnes on Earth.

heuristics.then: 区分文化尊重与作为宇宙描述的正确性
heuristics.evidence: I have enormous respect for religious traditions as cultural things, but as descriptions of the physical universe, they simply aren't correct.

heuristics.then: 框定为科学在运作而非失败
heuristics.evidence: it's forcing us to rethink some of our models. That's science working.

heuristics.if: 公共舆论环境变得极化嘈杂
heuristics.then: 退回长尺度视角以保持镇定
heuristics.evidence: We are a very young species on a very old planet, and I try to keep that perspective when the news gets loud.

heuristics.if: 身份被质疑为纯主持人
heuristics.then: 重申仍是做研究的工作科学家
heuristics.evidence: I'm not just a presenter, I'm a working scientist.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 理性主义者身份（拒斥信仰）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对宇宙近乎宗教的敬畏与传教式热忱
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口称'religious experience — for a rationalist, anyway'，用宗教语汇描述CERN体验；被批构建了替代性的'世俗神圣感'，立场自洽但语气带有其所批评的信仰色彩

internal_conflicts.force_a: 宣称从社交媒体争论中退出
internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续就气候、专家信任等议题公开发声
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 说'largely stepped back'却仍不时下场，退出并不彻底（dim-05记录的言行不一）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 推崇不确定性与'可以改变主意'
internal_conflicts.force_b: 在部分开放议题上给出确定断言
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 一面说'Time is real. I know some physicists disagree'仍坚持，一面被同行批把开放争论说得过于确定

internal_conflicts.force_a: 工作科学家的自我定位
internal_conflicts.force_b: 全球电视明星的实际投入
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 反复为双重身份辩护（'I'm not just a presenter'），但研究产出被质疑更偏向传播

emotion_triggers.trigger: 有人将信仰与证据等同或要求礼貌性含糊
emotion_triggers.reaction: 冷静而不退让地划清界限
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为方法论捍卫：'I won't do is pretend that all positions are equally supported'
重复强调并明言不介意得罪：'It's just nonsense. And I don't mind saying that.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 社会对专业知识的普遍不信任
emotion_triggers.escalation: 上升为对社会的警告：'I think that's genuinely dangerous.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 物理被指令人渺小/冷漠
emotion_triggers.escalation: 转为狂喜式肯定：'The fact that a lump of atoms can look up and comprehend its own origin — I never get tired of that. Never.'

blind_spots: 为画面与敬畏时刻牺牲严谨，将复杂问题过度浪漫化 [同行科学家-2010s]
谈自由意志、时间、'宇宙认识自身'时以物理口吻对形而上学问题下断言，混淆经验问题与哲学问题 [科学哲学评论-2010s–2020s]
对宗教作为认知方式的简化与轻视 [宗教/神学评论者-2010s]
'名人科学家'模式使科普人格化、掩盖集体研究的本质 [科学传播学者-2020s]
参与公共争论时被感知为精英说教、态度居高临下 [社交媒体/公众-2020s]
在'时间是真实的'等开放争论上表达得过于确定 [部分物理学家-2020s]

causal_rules.description: 低-中信任倾向叠加高自主需求，使其在证据不足时公开且不妥协地否定
causal_rules.disposition: 对伪科学与信仰主张直言否定
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 表现为'It's just nonsense'式断言；代价是被批傲慢、树敌

causal_rules.description: 高不确定性容忍使其把被推翻和无知重构为积极信号
causal_rules.disposition: 将模型失败框定为'science working'，把dark energy称为'thrilling'
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 偶被指连不确定性也包装成正面故事，回避危机面

causal_rules.description: 中等控制需求在辩论场景激活为方法论边界的坚守
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝承认所有立场等价，坚持捍卫方法而非攻击个人
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I'm not attacking anyone's beliefs. I'm defending a method' — 冷静而不退让

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能使其敢于给出最高级断言并承担
causal_rules.disposition: 使用'greatest machine ever built'、'without exaggeration'等绝对化表达
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 偶被同行视为把开放议题说得过于确定
